title: Executable OpenFOAM case generation for turbulent flow over a backward-facing step (FoamBench pitzDaily)

task_sources.name: CFDLLMBench FoamBench: the 10 pitzDaily cases of the Basic split (OpenFOAM v10 revision provided by the FoamBench authors) and evaluation scripts, BSD-3-Clause

metric.description: Execution success rate (M_exec in CFDLLMBench) over the 10 FoamBench Basic pitzDaily cases: the fraction of cases whose submitted OpenFOAM case, run unchanged by the verifier within the case's wall-clock limit, exits with status 0, names the specified solver in system/controlDict, and writes fields after the initial time whose values are all finite. Higher is better; 0 means no case runs. The linear display transform maps 0.0 to 0 and 0.836 to 1000, without capping either end. 0.836 is the execution success of Foam-Agent with Claude 3.5 Sonnet over all 110 FoamBench Basic cases in CFDLLMBench; no result for the pitzDaily cases alone is published. FoamBench's NMSE diagnostics are reported but not ranked.

baseline.name: Foam-Agent (RAG + reviewer) with Claude 3.5 Sonnet, execution success over all 110 FoamBench Basic cases reported in CFDLLMBench (Table 2)
